reviewContext.coreQuestion: In PRODUCTION (FOUNDER_TEST unset), can the earner write a USDC number it did not really receive on-chain to the ledger the public dashboard reads?
reviewContext.coreAnswer: NO. The prod trust root is the env-independent literal '/Users/operator/.anicca-founder' (record-earn.mjs:25). Every override env (HOME, FOUNDER_DIR, FOUNDER_WALLET, FOUNDER_LEDGER, FOUNDER_USDC_NOW, FOUNDER_USDC_BASELINE, BASE_RPC_URL) and os.homedir() is reachable ONLY under FOUNDER_TEST=1. No prod env can move the root, swap the wallet, fake the balance, or relocate the ledger.

evidence.description: INV-1 enforced: SHARED wallet rejected (47), positive pin against FOUNDER_WALLET_EXPECTED rejects any other wallet (48).
INV-3 enforced: ledger must realpath-resolve inside the founder dir, symlink-deref via realpathSync of nearest existing ancestor.
INV-6 fail-closed: RPC failure -> die; delta<=0 -> die; no write.
FIND-007 honored: first run initializes baseline to current and records nothing.
FIND-402 closed: behavioral PROD-mode case (FOUNDER_TEST unset) with HOME=planted .anicca-founder{pinned wallet, baseline=0} asserts NO fabricated row lands in the planted dir.
Static assert that the prod founder dir is an env-independent literal '/Users/operator/.anicca-founder' (grep -qF).
Corrupt-baseline fail-closed and INV-3 symlink-escape both covered.
FIND-401 closed: prod FOUNDER_DIR is the literal '/Users/operator/.anicca-founder'; HOME/os.homedir()/FOUNDER_DIR are inside the TEST-only ternary branch and unreachable in prod.
FIND-403 closed: realpathSync(FOUNDER_DIR) wrapped in try/catch -> friendly die('founder dir missing/unreadable ... gen-wallet/init first').
Enumerated every process.env.* read: all overrides TEST-gated; only process.env.FOUNDER_TEST (mode switch, cannot move root) is read unconditionally.

FIND-404 (hardcoded pin) is now acceptable defense-in-depth: with the prod root env-independent, wallet.json is always the canonical founder wallet, so the pin can only ever match the real wallet; residual risk is config-drift bricking on rotation, recorded as non-blocking FIND-501.
Earn is a pure delta of two on-chain reads vs strict baseline; baseline advanced atomically BEFORE append (crash = honest under-count, never double-count).
Live prod state confirmed: wallet.json.address == FOUNDER_WALLET_EXPECTED (0x810f6d61...), baseline file = 0 (well-formed).
